evals.prompt: Set up a headless browser fleet to audit all 47 pages of our educational platform for broken links, missing images, and JavaScript errors. We need full coverage with results in under 10 minutes.
evals.expected_output: A fleet orchestration plan specifying instance count, page distribution, audit checks, and timing to achieve full coverage of 47 pages in under 10 minutes
assertions: Response must specify the number of headless browser instances needed and how pages are distributed across them
Response must define specific audit checks for broken links, missing images, and JS errors with detection methods
Response must include timing estimates that demonstrate feasibility of completing within the 10-minute constraint

evals.prompt: Our browser fleet keeps crashing during large-scale scraping jobs. We're running 20 Puppeteer instances and 3 of them become unresponsive after 15 minutes. Diagnose and fix.
evals.expected_output: A diagnostic analysis of fleet instability with root cause identification (memory leaks, resource exhaustion, etc.) and specific remediation steps
assertions: Response must identify likely root causes for Puppeteer instance crashes such as memory leaks, zombie processes, or resource exhaustion
Response must propose specific configuration fixes including memory limits, page lifecycle management, and instance recycling
Response must include monitoring recommendations to detect and auto-remediate unstable instances

evals.prompt: Design a browser automation pipeline using Pinchtab to monitor our competitors' pricing pages (5 competitor sites) daily and alert us to any changes.
evals.expected_output: A complete automation pipeline design with scheduling, page monitoring, change detection logic, and alerting configuration for 5 competitor sites
assertions: Response must define a pipeline architecture with scheduling, browser automation, and change detection components
Response must specify change detection logic that distinguishes meaningful pricing changes from cosmetic updates
Response must include alerting configuration with notification channels and escalation for significant changes

evals.prompt: We need to validate that our web application renders correctly across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. Set up a cross-browser fleet that runs visual regression tests on our 12 key pages.
evals.expected_output: A cross-browser testing fleet configuration with visual regression testing setup, screenshot comparison logic, and pass/fail criteria for 12 pages across 3 browsers
assertions: Response must configure headless instances for all 3 browsers with appropriate viewport and rendering settings
Response must define visual regression comparison methodology with pixel diff thresholds and baseline management
Response must specify which 12 page types to prioritize and what visual elements to validate on each

evals.prompt: Scale our audit fleet to handle 500 pages across 3 different client sites simultaneously. What is the optimal instance count, and how do we prevent resource contention?
evals.expected_output: A fleet scaling plan with instance sizing, resource allocation, isolation strategy, and load balancing for concurrent multi-site auditing
assertions: Response must calculate optimal instance count based on pages-per-instance throughput and target completion time
Response must address resource contention with specific isolation strategies (containers, resource limits, queue management)
Response must include a load balancing strategy that prevents any single client site from starving others

should_trigger: Set up headless browsers to audit all pages on our website for errors
Our Puppeteer fleet keeps crashing, how do we fix it?
Automate daily monitoring of competitor pricing pages
Run cross-browser visual regression tests on our key pages
Scale our browser fleet to handle 500 pages across multiple sites
should_not_trigger: Evaluate an external AI assistant for integration into our workflow
Build a threat model for our authentication system
Design adaptive interfaces that reduce cognitive load
What emerging technologies should we add to our 2027 roadmap?
Create a product roadmap for the next quarter
